# mozilla — 2023 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 192 mozilla CVEs of 2023 are in `data/cve/vendors/mozilla/2023.jsonl`.

### CVE-2023-0163 — Prototype Pollution in convict
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2024-11-26 | Updated: 2024-11-27 | Max CVSS: 8.4
- CWE: CWE-1321 CWE-1321 Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.4 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution') vulnerability in Mozilla Convict.

This allows an attacker to inject attributes that are used in other components, or to override existing attributes with ones that have incompatible type, which may lead to a crash.


The main use case of Convict is for handling server-side 
configurations written by the admins owning the servers, and not random 
users. So it's unlikely that an admin would deliberately sabotage their 
own server. Still, a situation can happen where an admin not 
knowledgeable about JavaScript could be tricked by an attacker into 
writing the malicious JavaScript code into some config files.



This issue affects Convict: before 6.2.4.

Affected:
- Mozilla / Convict: affected 0 <6.2.4 (semver)
- mozilla / convict: affected 0 <6.2.4 (semver)

Credits: Captain-K-101

References:
- https://github.com/mozilla/node-convict/issues/410 [issue-tracking]
- https://github.com/mozilla/node-convict/security/advisories/GHSA-4jrm-c32x-w4jf [vendor-advisory]

### CVE-2023-0430
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2023-06-02 | Updated: 2025-01-10 | Max CVSS: 6.5
- CWE: Revocation status of S/Mime signature certificates was not checked; CWE-295 CWE-295 Improper Certificate Validation

Certificate OCSP revocation status was not checked when verifying S/Mime signatures. Mail signed with a revoked certificate would be displayed as having a valid signature. Thunderbird versions from 68 to 102.7.0 were affected by this bug. This vulnerability affects Thunderbird < 102.7.1.

### CVE-2023-1521 — Local Privilege Escalation in sccache
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2024-11-26 | Updated: 2024-11-26 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: CWE-426 CWE-426 Untrusted Search Path
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

On Linux the sccache client can execute arbitrary code with the privileges of a local sccache server, by preloading the code in a shared library passed to LD_PRELOAD.


If the server is run as root (which is the default when installing the  snap package https://snapcraft.io/sccache ), this means a user running the sccache client can get root privileges.

Affected:
- Mozilla / sccache: affected 0 <0.4.0 (semver)
- mozilla / sccache: affected 0 <0.4.0 (semver)

Credits: Paolo Tranquilli (@redsun82)

References:
- https://securitylab.github.com/advisories/GHSL-2023-046_ScCache [third-party-advisory]
- https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-x7fr-pg8f-93f5 [vendor-advisory]

### CVE-2023-2142 — Nunjucks autoescape bypass leads to cross site scripting
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2024-11-26 | Updated: 2024-11-27 | Max CVSS: 6.1
- CWE: CWE-79 CWE-79 Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation (XSS or 'Cross-site Scripting')

In Nunjucks versions prior to version 3.2.4, it was 
possible to bypass the restrictions which are provided by the autoescape
 functionality. If there are two user-controlled parameters on the same 
line used in the views, it was possible to inject cross site scripting 
payloads using the backslash \ character.

- mozilla / nunjucks: affected 0 <3.2.4 (semver)

### CVE-2023-4583 — Browsing Context potentially not cleared when closing Private Window
- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2023-09-11 | Updated: 2025-12-18 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-754 CWE-754 Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

When checking if the Browsing Context had been discarded in `HttpBaseChannel`, if the load group was not available then it was assumed to have already been discarded which was not always the case for private channels after the private session had ended. This vulnerability affects Firefox < 117, Firefox ESR < 115.2, and Thunderbird < 115.2.

Affected:
- Mozilla / Firefox: affected unspecified <117 (custom)
- Mozilla / Firefox ESR: affected unspecified <115.2 (custom)
- Mozilla / Thunderbird: affected unspecified <115.2 (custom)

- CWE: One-time permissions granted to a local file were extended to other local files loaded in the same tab; CWE-281 CWE-281 Improper Preservation of Permissions
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

If temporary "one-time" permissions, such as the ability to use the Camera, were granted to a document loaded using a file: URL, that permission persisted in that tab for all other documents loaded from a file: URL. This is potentially dangerous if the local files came from different sources, such as in a download directory. This vulnerability affects Firefox < 111.

Affected:
- Mozilla / Firefox: affected unspecified <111 (custom)

References:
- https://www.mozilla.org/security/advisories/mfsa2023-09/
- https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1811181

- Assigner: mozilla | Published: 2023-07-05 | Updated: 2025-02-13 | Max CVSS: 7.8

- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

### CVE-2023-42808 — Common Voice Cross-site Scripting vulnerability
- Assigner: GitHub_M | Published: 2023-10-04 | Updated: 2024-09-19 | Max CVSS: 6.1
- CWE: CWE-79 CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 6.1 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=poc, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

Common Voice is the web app for Mozilla Common Voice, a platform for collecting speech donations in order to create public domain datasets for training voice recognition-related tools. Version 1.88.2 is vulnerable to reflected Cross-Site Scripting given that user-controlled data flows to a path expression (path of a network request). This issue may lead to reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in the context of Common Voice’s server origin. As of time of publication, it is unknown whether any patches or workarounds exist.

Affected:
- Mozilla / common-voice: affected <= 1.88.2
